output.reason: [ev-8f68e1e40d83] says that before the fix, the directory of cloned git repos (gitRepoPaths) and the Helm chart cache (chartCachePaths) were keyed by repo URL plus project name. That meant a repo shared by several projects was cloned again for each one. The fix removes the project from both keys. [ev-aa238df92e7f] and [ev-1b2170431290] tie this to project-scoped repository credentials and say security is unchanged, because the credentials are still stored per project in Kubernetes secrets. So exposure is setups that use project-scoped repo credentials with the same repo URL in more than one project, and the effect is a performance fix with nothing for the operator to do.
